ionicNavNote: Reached from Home's radio alert ('Enter Coupon Code', params {mode:'home'}); the page never reads params. The harness uses setRoot like the other states. No endpoint is called on load.

ionicNav: nav.setRoot(Page('CoupanCode'), params).then(() => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600))).then(() => { const inj = window.ng.probe(document.querySelector('ion-app')).injector; inj.get(window.ng.coreTokens.NgZone).run(() => { nav.getActive().instance.submit(undefined); }); })
ionicNavNote: Submit with the box empty: flag=1 shows 'Required', karigarCoupon answers REQUIRED and the 'Alert!' / 'Please Enter Coupon Code' alert opens. The button click is driven as submit(data.code) inside NgZone (TapClick swallows synthetic clicks).
